author: prosenjitghosh
text:
Hi Friends, I went through all the materials I found here in RTM, whether it is Marketpedia, Homework section or Journals, I found all of them to be extremely important and simple to learn, nevertheless to say, this is a Gem of a Community, where all the members are actively participating, sharing and learning together.

Well I believe, "Knowledge is the only thing, that increases by sharing". And happy to see that happening here, time and again.

And this is what is knocking in my head, to open my own "Journal" to carry on with the spirit of "Learning by sharing". So henceforth, I will post here, all the analysis I do or whatever doubts I have or something new which I come across, in terms of RTM style of Trading and Psychology.

And one request, please do pardon my bad English, as my Mother Language is Bengali.

Thanks and Regards, Prosenjit (PG)
